name: Natsuki Naoko
description: Natsuki Naoko is the mother of Natsuki Subaru and wife of Natsuki Kenichi. Known for her eccentric, loving personality and profound love of mayonnaise that Subaru inherited, she appears during Subaru's First Trial in the Sanctuary during Arc 4. Her unconditional acceptance and heartfelt parting conversation grant Subaru the closure and resolve needed to forge ahead.
